Viewed In one of the darkest hours in America, these heroes stepped up. And now they even have to fight for healthcare.
 



After Musk and Trump derailed the bipartisan stopgap bill needed to fund the government through early next year, Congressional leaders had to go back to the table to make deep cuts… or else face government shutdown. 





One of those cuts was removing funding for the World Trade Center Health Program through 2040. This health program was created to provide treatment and medical monitoring of 9/11 responders and survivors, including those sickened by the toxins and pollution that hung over NYC for days after the tragedy. 





Over 130,000 people have enrolled in the WTC Health Program, including over 7,000 this year alone as more information has come to light about 9/11 related illnesses. 





Now these same responders and survivors may have to march on Washington again to demand the funding of the program.
